company_name: Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board - Govt of Andhra Pradesh
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The board is actively involved in promoting and facilitating semiconductor industry growth in Andhra Pradesh, focusing on infrastructure and policy support.
summary: The Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board is focused on promoting the semiconductor industry within the state by attracting investments in manufacturing and design. It facilitates the establishment of fabrication plants and research facilities, and supports workforce development and industry collaboration.

regional_presence.India: The board is focused on developing Andhra Pradesh as a key region for semiconductor manufacturing and research facilities.
